description: Transparent, always-on-top desktop widget canvas with notes, clocks, links, media, system stats, and other widgets.
notes: Review: the official x64 and ARM64 assets are Tauri/NSIS setup executables. No separate portable Windows package is published.

This manifest stages the official setup executable only. It deliberately does not execute the vendor installer or claim that Layer itself is installed; the NSIS extraction path and a Scoop-contained install method have not been verified.

The upstream Tauri configuration sets installMode to both. Tauri issue #16006 reports that silent installation can ignore the /D installation-directory parameter in this mode, so passing $dir cannot currently be treated as a verified installation path.

The source repository has an MIT LICENSE, but the distributed installer also includes src-tauri/eula.txt with separate redistribution terms. The binary license is therefore left as Unknown pending clarification.
